description: Estimate Canadian capital gains tax on selling real estate, stocks, crypto, a business or a rental. Applies the flat 50% inclusion rate, principal-residence exemption, lifetime capital gains exemption for QSBC shares, capital-loss offsets and rental CCA recapture, then taxes the gain on top of other income at federal + provincial brackets.

annualIncome.description: Other annual income in CAD; the gain is taxed on top of it

assetType.description: What was sold; decides which exemptions apply

buyingCosts.description: Land transfer tax, legal and other buying costs

capitalImprovements.description: Capital improvements added to the adjusted cost base

capitalLosses.description: Capital losses (prior or current) to offset the gain

ccaClaimedToDate.description: Rental only: total CCA claimed to date

isPrincipalResidence.description: Real estate only: claim the principal residence exemption

isQSBC.description: Business only: qualified small business corporation shares (LCGE)

landValue.description: Rental only: land portion of the sale price (splits land vs building gain)

lcgeRemaining.description: Remaining lifetime capital gains exemption room in CAD

originalBuildingCost.description: Rental only: original building cost for CCA recapture

sellingCosts.description: Commission, legal and other selling costs

yearsDesignated.description: Years designated as your principal residence

name: capital_gains_tax
title: Canadian Capital Gains Tax Calculator
